urls.sampling: random sample up to 40000 per class (seed 42)
urls.limitation: Legitimate and phishing URLs come from different collections. Models can partly learn collection-specific artefacts, so test metrics are optimistic compared with real-world traffic.

emails.positive_label_meaning: 'spam' class of Enron-Spam (spam / unsolicited scam-style mail, NOT curated phishing)
emails.limitation: Enron-Spam is a spam/ham corpus. The positive class is spam/scam mail, not strictly phishing. Train on a phishing corpus (Nazario/CEAS-08) for a phishing-specific model.
